description: Catch up: what a person or group did, and where they were named, in a window; newest first per kind. who: a name (fuzzy; close matches return ambiguous), email, hash:<8 hex>, team:<slug>, org:<name>, new:<window>, or a list. Kinds: waiting (one person, no topic: their open items, each with rule, priority 0-100, why, outlook, p_reply, p_more_replies; finished threads (a commit, a closed entry, a quiet thread, or a last message that only thanks or reports the work done: done_reason acknowledged / work_done) only counted in left_out unless done=show), acted, mail_from, mail_to_cc, mail_mention, git_author, git_credit, git_mention, wiki_edit, wiki_mention, commitfest, calendar, roster. Names, hashes and urls, never addresses. ~4 s budget (late kinds in timed_out). Same as GET /api/v2/activity.

done.description: Finished waiting threads: hide (default) or show

during.description: Calendar event uid or url, or pg19: its dates

since.description: Date, 2w, today, pg19 or all (default 14 days ago)

topic.description: Narrows every kind by hybrid search, e.g. NUMA

name: whats_new
